## Summary

I identified and resolved ticket T-4008. The issue was that the ingress-nginx controller v1.12.1 upgrade disabled snippet annotations by default (`allow-snippet-annotations=false`) for security. The legacy-portal Ingress was relying on `configuration-snippet` annotations to perform regex-based URL redirects from `/old/*` to `/portal/*`, but these directives are now silently rejected by the controller, causing 404 responses instead of redirects. 

The fix is for the platform team to enable snippet annotations in the controller configuration. I confirmed all pods are healthy and provided evidence from the controller logs showing the annotation rejection.
